title: Choose MIRA’s next direction
question: Compare the visual studies. Choose a direction, or request a fresh round. These are design proposals with fictional content, not changes to your live app.

options.label: Studio
options.thesis: A practical family workspace with a confident cobalt spine and one clear invitation.
options.viewport: Persistent navigation, a useful activity brief, and an inline plan-change review.
options.risk: The strong color and larger activity treatment may feel louder than you want.

raised.raise: Every suggested change makes its effects on time and preparation explicit.
Every action has a visible label and an unmistakable state.
The week preserves the distinction between prepared invitations and unstructured time.
AI context and parent corrections remain inspectable.
Focus, selection and disabled states must work without color.

options.label: Daily Brief
options.thesis: A focused daily brief that helps a busy parent decide in seconds.
options.viewport: Compact navigation beside a readable day list; details and AI proposals share a side pane.
options.risk: The most familiar option; distinction depends on excellent content and interaction details.

options.label: Unfold
options.thesis: A compact day that opens into instructions only when you need them.
options.viewport: A slim week strip above expanding activity rows, with a visible before-and-after change sheet.
options.case: Strong on progressive disclosure and phone use; less conventional than a persistent sidebar.
options.risk: Expansion must preserve your place, and controls must stay familiar.

options.label: Tension structures
options.thesis: A map of competing family constraints.
options.viewport: Considered as a system for Today, Week and parent guidance.
options.risk: Force graphs would make daily parenting decisions harder to read.
options.case: Force graphs would make daily parenting decisions harder to read.
options.kept: Visible consequences for every proposed change.

options.label: Tape-deck controls
options.viewport: Considered as a system for Today, Week and parent guidance.
options.risk: Retro instrument styling could distract from ordinary caregiving.
options.case: Retro instrument styling could distract from ordinary caregiving.

options.label: Dance notation
options.thesis: A vertical score of the family's day.
options.viewport: Considered as a system for Today, Week and parent guidance.
options.risk: Precise duration notation risks implying a child timetable.
options.case: Precise duration notation risks implying a child timetable.

options.label: Terminal transcript
options.viewport: Considered as a system for Today, Week and parent guidance.
options.risk: A chat-first terminal conflicts with MIRA's structured parent experience.
options.case: A chat-first terminal conflicts with MIRA's structured parent experience.

options.label: One-bit desktop
options.thesis: Separate windows for planning and reflection.
options.viewport: Considered as a system for Today, Week and parent guidance.
options.risk: Overlapping windows add work on a phone.
options.case: Overlapping windows add work on a phone.
options.kept: Selection and focus visible without color.

canonCard.label: Familiar essentials
canonCard.thesis: A conventional, restrained app with standard navigation and clear lists.
canonCard.viewport: A simple daily list with standard tabs and a separate details screen.
canonCard.risk: Easy to recognise, but with less individual character.
